ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 95:5 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels; the visible fluke surface is dominated by high-reflectance pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A single contiguous high-intensity (white) region occupies the central and proximal areas; low-intensity (black) pixels are restricted to a thin perimeter along the trailing edge and solid clusters at the distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a pixel convergence angle of approximately 70 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (micro-peaks) distributed uniformly along the posterior boundary from notch to tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge exhibits a slightly concave curve starting from the median notch, transitioning to convex at the distal lobe tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Low-intensity tan/yellowish pixel cluster located at the central basal region near the peduncle interface.
other_distinctive_markers: Exceptional uniformity of high-intensity white pigmentation across the entire ventral surface compared to typical species mottling patterns.
